summary: Ripley County, MO 100-foot Aermotor LS40 tower built 1958-59 on MDC's Doniphan Towersite; tornado-destroyed and rebuilt in 1985; closed to the public for repairs.

facts.status_note: MDC notice says closed to the public for repairs (undated); the register says it was in good shape as of 2023

staffing.status: used for fire detection only during peak fire season (per register)

access.note: MDC notice says the firetower is closed to the public for repairs (undated); the register says it was not open to the public as of 2023

visit.trail_note: Reached by a gravel road to the top of the hill at the towersite; the tower is closed to the public. Do not climb.

events.note: Register gives the build period as 1958-1959
New garage built at the Doniphan Towersite (FY1964-65)
Tornado destroyed the tower in February 1985
Listed as rebuilt after the February 1985 tornado; no rebuild date given
Registered December 31, 2023; nominated by Jerry Lutes

notes_for_editor: Brief's 1958 build year is the start of the register's 1958-1959 range (correction applied in story 2026-10-09). The 1985 tornado and rebuild come only from the Forest Lookouts site, which gives no rebuild date. The MDC closure notice is undated. Not read: the Eminence Towersites plan PDF on archive.org (timed out twice); Facebook posts (tornado damage, lower steps removed to prevent climbing) appeared only as search snippets and are not used. A separate 'Doniphan Water Tower' entry appears in the Forest Lookouts index and was not checked. About 4 page reads used.
